response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong testing culture, some high-throughput distributed systems exposure, and community mentoring activity, but he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~6 months professionally at National Instruments plus a thesis project). His background is predominantly full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud compute infrastructure, and he has no formal technical-leadership or people-mentoring role managing cloud/DevOps engineers, making him a poor fit for this specific technical lead position despite his overall seniority.
strengths: Strong distributed systems experience with low-latency, high-throughput microservices (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Deep testing and software craftsmanship expertise (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, ran workshops and courses)
Broad, long-tenured engineering career spanning backend, infrastructure tooling, Kubernetes, and Docker
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ — professional C++ experience is roughly 6 months
No formal technical leadership role leading strategy, priorities, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers on record
Career focus is web/product full-stack development, not large-scale cloud compute platforms or hardware/storage architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership experience
